title: Manifest's capability-coverage row 4 (production.ts wires tavilySearchFn unconditionally) prescribes an inadmissible two-file falsifying edit (production.ts AND ask-web-fallback.ts both reverted), not a single-hunk edit to one file named in 'What changed'
evidence: Manifest row 4 falsifying-edit cell describes a two-file mutation: production.ts reverted to a truthy-gated conditional spread, AND ask-web-fallback.ts's createTavilySearchFn reverted to return undefined. Per checker SKILL.md's capability-coverage rule, a falsifying edit is admissible ONLY as a single-hunk edit to a single file named in 'What changed'; a multi-file edit is CONTRACT_MISMATCH and must not be executed as pasted. This checker did not execute the manifest's two-file cell. Instead, in a throwaway copy (iss274-row4), this checker independently verified the underlying capability with its own single-file mutation restricted to production.ts alone (the wired tavilySearchFn field changed to tavilySearchFn: undefined): BEFORE 2/2 pass, AFTER 1 fail/1 pass with AssertionError 'tavilySearchFn must be present ... actual undefined vs expected function', control test unaffected, restored clean (cmp verified). The underlying capability is real and independently confirmed; only the manifest's own falsification methodology for this row was non-compliant.
fix_direction: Process fix for future manifests on this seam: when a capability is only observably false-able by touching two composed files (a truthy-seam plus its always-returns-a-function guarantee), name and falsify ONE file's contribution at a time in two separate rows, or accept a single-file falsification that is slightly less precise (as this checker did) rather than pasting a two-file edit as one row's evidence. No functional code defect -- this is a manifest-evidence-methodology issue, and the checker's own independent single-file check already supersedes it for this unit's verdict.
reproductions: Read qa/manifests/iss-274-wire-web-fallback.md row 4 cell verbatim -- names two files and two edits as one falsification.
Checker's own iss274-row4 throwaway-copy single-file mutation on production.ts alone reproduces a real, isolated failure matching the capability's claim.
notes: Filed low: no auth/tenancy/data-write surface, does not change the checked-PASS/FAIL outcome for the underlying capability since it was independently reverified by a compliant method.
